current_scene: Concealed Copper Finch wagon after thorough search and recovery marking
current_location: Emberglass region — basalt wash east of Cinderwash Turnoff
last_sync_note: Session 1, Turn 6 is resolved. DevilMedlar thoroughly searched the concealed Copper Finch wagon while Senpai assisted. DevilMedlar Investigation 4 produced no reliable new deduction; Senpai Perception 15 found a fragment of blue-gray Meridian Archive sealing wax beneath a cargo-board edge and brief human-sized foot impressions leaving the wash beside the second wagon trail, supporting that the missing dispatch case had been in this wagon and that at least one person left the site on foot, without proving whether willingly or under guard. DevilMedlar and Senpai documented the wagon, remaining cargo, blood, axle sabotage, missing case, and eastbound trail; they left a secured recovery note and marked a retrieval route from the old road with a cairn, tied wagon-canvas strip, and scratched directional mark. The strongest trail still leads east toward Suncoil Watch. Both characters are at 180 / 300 XP with combat resources full.
